setup.selection_metric: mean(LOCAL recall with correct slave pooled over impact+shift, BUILDING recall pooled over 2x/3x/5x); ties: AMBIENT recall, simpler rule, lower T, smoothed variant

note: R2 (per-superframe AMBIENT recall >= 0.95 criterion) was scored once on its test block (seeds 5,200,000+); R2b (event-level criterion, FINAL) uses fresh blocks 6,100,000+ / 6,200,000+.
